description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget called ProfileScreen, which displays user profile information, including authentication status, user details, and a list of custom recipes. It provides UI components for signing in/out, viewing recipes, and navigating to recipe detail and form screens.

classes.name: ProfileScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget representing the user profile screen with authentication status and recipe list.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the profile screen, including user info, sign-in/sign-out button, and a grid of custom recipes.
